dict.string: 2FA and login-code texts sent to your main iPhone's number show up here as notifications from the real sender. Your main iPhone relays only those texts, over iMessage, with a Shortcuts automation (setup below).
When a relayed text has a verification code in it, the code goes on the clipboard and the notification title says Code Copied.
A code sent as an iMessage already comes here directly. When the same text also arrives relayed within 3 minutes, only the first one alerts.

Shortcuts > Automation > New Automation > Message. Message Contains: a single space. Run Immediately, Notify When Run off. Actions: Match Text (the regex on SMS Relay's slopkit page) in the message text; If Matches has any value, Send Message to your own number with the text "[SMS] " + Sender, a new line, then the message text. Mute your own-number chat on the main iPhone. The regex and these steps are on SMS Relay’s slopkit page: mbucc9000.github.io/slopkit
